# Serenia Kiwale

> Serenia by House of Jets, Kiwale, Pune: 2, 3 BHK and Simplex 4/6 BHK flats from ₹95 Lakh near Mukai Chowk. A marketing website that collects enquiries for the project's sales team. Prices, areas and specifications are indicative and subject to change; verify RERA (PM1260002602794) on MahaRERA.
